items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And, Louis took us all up there to see Freddy Keppert, and he was like on his death bed.

ctx.x: -- Freddy Keppert, they don't think he's going to live too long. And, here was a name I knew, but I'd never met the man. And, Louis took us all up there to see Freddy Keppert, and he was like on his death bed.
